worker_choices.moments_powers_from_v2: Accept with a flag. Byte-identical to v2 in all 7,545 observations (per-observation hash). Moments are angle independent. Powers vs moment x new joint speed (gradient of the new angle over stride time): median r 0.993 hip, 0.998 knee, 0.995 ankle, signs agree, but median normalised RMS difference is 0.114 / 0.088 / 0.163 (v2 own angles: 0.070 / 0.048 / 0.067). So powers remain consistent in shape and sign with the new speeds, but not equal to moment x new speed; the ankle differs most because its zero and definition changed. limitations.json states powers were not recomputed from the new marker angles; the README does not say the amplitude gap. Recommendation: either recompute powers as moment x new joint speed (D-UM21-T04-3 B) or keep and state the gap; not a blocker for a review package.
